build.name: stage the two testprog files as a module-less main package (crash_test.go is the expectation file, not built)
build.cmd: export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin; mkdir -p $BODY/build/prog && cp deadlock.go main.go $BODY/build/prog/ && cd $BODY/build/prog && go mod init testprog >/dev/null 2>&1; go vet . 2>&1 | tail -2; go build -o $BODY/build/testprog . && echo built

runs.name: SimpleDeadlock: main blocks on a channel nobody sends to

stdout.text:
fatal error: all goroutines are asleep - deadlock!

goroutine 1 [select (no cases)]:
main.SimpleDeadlock()
	/w/build/prog/deadlock.go:45 +0xf
main.main()
exit=2

runs.name: LockedDeadlock: the deadlock with the main goroutine locked to its thread

stdout.text:
fatal error: all goroutines are asleep - deadlock!

goroutine 1 [select (no cases), locked to thread]:
main.LockedDeadlock()
	/w/build/prog/deadlock.go:56 +0x14
main.main()
exit=2

runs.name: LockedDeadlock2: two goroutines, one locked, both waiting

stdout.text:
fatal error: all goroutines are asleep - deadlock!

goroutine 1 [select (no cases)]:
main.LockedDeadlock2()

runs.name: GoexitDeadlock: main calls Goexit while others block
